name: v1.39.5 - Modules weaviate_module_error_total metric labels Fix
body:
## Breaking Changes 
*none*

## New Features
*none*

## Fixes
* Fix shifted weaviate_module_error_total labels and qna-openai nil-response panic by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13048
* fix(hnsw): tolerate a tombstoned entrypoint whose node slot is nil by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13031
* Fix auto schema with refs on namespaced cluster by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13037
* Return 403 from verbose /v1/nodes to callers denied minimal output by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13050
* Optimize listing backups with many collections by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13008
* test: switch minio/minio image to cgr.dev/chainguard/minio by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13052
* fix(schema): drop class data the schema no longer names and handle orphans by @moogacs in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13017
* Trim claude.md to save context by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13057
* Docs links on out-of-memory-mappings errors (logs and API) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12738
* Fix replica movement to be enable-able via runtime config by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13064
* fix(drop-vector-index): clear the dropped vector's dimension rows by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12918
* fix(objects): stop re-call  the class the reference write already read by @moogacs in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13068


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/compare/v1.39.4...v1.39.5
